findings.title: The R2-F1 fix mistakes JSX expressions for tag boundaries
findings.body: `openTagAt` searches raw `<` and `>` characters, but both can occur inside JSX attribute expressions before the diagnosed attribute. In a child-process reproduction, `<Input leading={<Icon />} autoFocus>` produced the unqualified fingerprint `autoFocus`; replacing `Input` with `Textarea` then incorrectly returned PASS. Likewise, `disabled={count < limit}` can identify `limit` as the element, making an unrelated variable rename change the fingerprint. This reintroduces the same-file, same-rule, different-element false green that the accepted partial contract requires the hard gate to reject. The new fixtures only exercise plain opening tags and closed siblings.
findings.recommendation: Resolve the owning JSX opening element with an AST or a JSX-aware balanced scan. Add child-process fixtures requiring nested-JSX/comparison attribute replacement across different elements to FAIL, while expression-only renames remain PASS.
